answer: The raven decay curve is applied at each close, comet records the drop, and pigment recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 8 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. That bill is paid per identity, so 245 aliases cost 41 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
